content.title: What channel is Arkansas basketball vs Oklahoma on today? Time, TV schedule, prediction
content.text: March 13, 2026, 4:03 a.m. CTNASHVILLE, Tenn. — March Madness has officially arrived for Arkansas basketball.The Razorbacks (23-8) will begin their postseason journey tonight in the quarterfinals of the SEC Tournament. They are the No. 3 seed, and after receiving a double-bye, will face No. 11 Oklahoma on Friday, March 13.The Sooners advanced to this round with a dominant victory over the No. 6 Texas A&M on Thursday. This will be the second meeting between Arkansas and Oklahoma, with the Hogs going on the road to win the regular-season encounter 83-79.Arkansas hasn't played since knocking off Missouri 88-84 in overtime last weekend. The Razorbacks won without Darius Acuff Jr., who rested a nagging ankle injury but is expected to return for tonight's game.Here's a look at how to watch today's SEC Quarterfinal between Arkansas and Oklahoma.Stream Arkansas basketball vs Oklahoma in SEC TournamentWhat channel is Arkansas basketball vs Oklahoma on today?TV Channel: SEC NetworkLivestream: Fubo (free trial), ESPN+Arkansas vs. Oklahoma will broadcast nationally on SEC Network. Tom Hart and Dane Bradshaw will call the game from Bridgestone Arena, with Alyssa Lang reporting from the sidelines. The game is available to stream on Fubo, which offers a free trial to new subscribers, and ESPN+.Arkansas vs Oklahoma time todayDate: Friday, March 13Start time: 8:30 p.m. CTThe Arkansas vs. Oklahoma game is scheduled to start at 8:30 p.m., or 25 minutes after the conclusion of the preceding game.Stream Arkansas vs OklahomaArkansas vs Oklahoma predictionThis should be another tight game. Oklahoma has the athleticism and size to give the Hogs problems, but the Sooners don't have an answer for Darius Acuff Jr. The Razorbacks will be the fresher squad and clinch a spot in the SEC Tournament semifinals. Arkansas 88, Oklahoma 82.Arkansas' potential SEC Tournament scheduleFriday, March 13: Quarterfinals vs. OklahomaSaturday, March 14: Semifinals vs. Alabama or Ole MissSunday, March 15: Final vs. one of Florida, Kentucky, Tennessee or VanderbiltJackson Fuller covers Arkansas football, basketball and baseball for the Southwest Times Record, part of the USA TODAY Network.
